opening.argument: The presentation promotes Mirror Trading International as a Bitcoin trading program built around recurring returns and daily compounding. The speaker reports averages of “about 0.5% daily to 12% monthly,” while linking participation to earning Bitcoin and compounding money daily. He describes payouts as coming from a pool, claims the trading pool has reached 345 Bitcoin, and presents a trading result of 0.5335%. Viewers are directed to contact him to obtain the presentation link and learn how to participate. Although he says the returns are not guaranteed and some opportunities may not last, those qualifications do not change the central invitation: obtain access through him to a program promoted through recurring pool-based returns and compounded Bitcoin earnings.
